text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to rescind the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of Windsor Street, between a point 15 metres south of Newcastle Street and a point 20 metres further south. The proposed removal is a result of a request from GO train commuters, forwarded by the Ward Councillor, to create additional parking on-street near the Mimico Station.

Etobicoke York Community Council : 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of Windsor Street, between a point 15 metres south of Newcastle Street and a point 20 metres further south.
